_comment: Round 2 (SEM micrographs). Measured on 1325 verified pairs. See docs/ROUND2_EDA.md.

kernel_identification.method: spectral distance + lag-1 autocorrelation + local variance
kernel_identification.note: Round-1 low-pass MSE was insensitive by construction - it discards the band where kernels differ, which is why it wrongly reported 'unidentifiable'. Two independent statistics converge on sigma ~0.55-0.60.
kernel_identification.residual_note: spec.dist stays ~0.22 across every kernel, so the remaining high-frequency gap is NOT kernel-related. Most likely cause is per-pixel-independent noise sampling missing real spatial structure. Revisit only if training underperforms.
kernel_identification.removed: bicubic_aa and lanczos destabilised the variance fit (local-variance ratios of 5.4 and 3864) and were the main source of the original synthetic/real mismatch.

_noise_fit_note: Fitted against the OLD 'area' kernel. Re-run scripts/build_residual_bank.py --refit to refit against gauss:0.6 before training.

round1_reference.note: Natural photographs, not comparable to round-2 scores.
